sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Money Merge is a match-three puzzle game where you're tasked with merging three or more coins of the same color to create sparkling ruby gems. The game's core premise is simple yet engaging, making it easy to pick up and play. However, as you progress through the levels, the game becomes increasingly challenging, requiring you to think strategically and plan your moves carefully. The game's core mechanics are built around the concept of merging coins, but that's where the simplicity ends. As you merge coins, you'll trigger explosive reactions that can either help or hinder your progress.

The game's explosive reactions are a key aspect of Money Merge's gameplay mechanics. These reactions can either clear large sections of the board, creating space for new coins to drop, or they can create new obstacles that make it harder to merge coins. The game's ability to create a sense of uncertainty and unpredictability adds a layer of excitement and challenge to the gameplay, keeping you on your toes at all times.

As you progress through the levels, you'll unlock new coins, crowns, and other power-ups that can be used to enhance your gameplay experience.
